narrative.offerRewardText:
Arranging the crystals on the table, you carefully align the colors. As you push the last one into place, a burst of light fuses the crystals together.

The resulting combination is now yours.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The Pylon table allows you to combine red power crystals with blue power crystals.

According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to weaken an enemy's defenses.
